g.text: Dragging above 1 means holding a fixed position is impossible; it is not a matter speed. Solid outlines mark half the peak density; faint matter extends beyond them.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #617287

g.text: Clocks shown are held at the centre of the hole. Distances, mass and spin use simulation units. Dynamical stability is untested.
